title: Quantitative proteomic and glycoproteomic analysis identifies CLCA1, FBN1, and FGB as potential biomarkers for ulcerative colitis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38044-38055
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05241F, Paper
Open Access

Xiaotong Wang, Siyue Bo, Qinkai Li, Wentong Li, Longjiang Xu, Duanmin Hu, Shuang Yang
Ulcerative colitis (UC), a prevalent inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), significantly increases the risk of colorectal cancer with prolonged duration. CLCA1, FGB, and FBN1 show promise as UC markers.
